title: feat(types,components)!: retire four zero-read or third-spelling keys, mirror two chatbot keys, file eighteen runtime slots by name (objectui#6152, round 4)
body:
Refs #6152
Clause-②: yes (narrowing). The two mirrors widen `@object-ui/types/zod` and the strict authoring face to keys the TypeScript face already invited and the renderers read (`requestBody`, `floatingConfig`). The four retirements (`label.content`, `report.chartConfig`, `report.reportType`, `detail-view.autoDiscoverRelated`) narrow both faces at once, under the startup no-gradualism rule. It is priced in `.changeset/6152-unmirrored-round4.md` as `minor`, with the break stated.

Round 4 of objectui#6152, dispatched under claim `5919877490` (the `domain:devx` seat 2, session `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`, on the maintainer's direct order). The rulings are the seat review `5914490915`: Q1 B, Q2 A, Q3 B. ⛔ This is a draft from a dispatched dev: do not mark it ready and do not enable auto-merge. The card stays open, because `ObjectGridSchema`, the spec-derived pairs and three `DataTableSchema` keys (below) are not this round's.

## What changed

1. **Q1 B: `LabelSchema.content` is retired.** It is `?: never` on `form.ts` and a `retirementTombstone` on `form.zod.ts` that names the kept spellings `text` and `label`. The `label` renderer drops its third read limb (`schema.text || schema.label`). Re-measured: 0 documents author it (JSON, Markdown JSON fences and typed literals); its only author was a test in `form-renderers.test.tsx`, which now pins the refusal. Which of `text` / `label` is canonical is not decided here.
2. **Q2 A: `DetailViewSchema` `activities`, `comments`, `history` and `recordNavigation` go to `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` by name.** Each has a row with its reason on `RuntimeOnlyNamedAllowList`, in round 3's shape. They carry host-fetched runtime data, and `recordNavigation.onNavigate` is a required function.
3. **Q3 B, under objectui#7654 ruling B: `displayMode` keeps its TypeScript-only refusal.** It gets no zod arm, because stored designer documents carry `displayMode: 'floating'` (pinned by `chatbot-display-mode-retired.test.ts`). The ledger entries no longer call the mirror half "owed"; the key stays listed by decision. Separately, after a reader census for each:
   - `ChatbotSchema.requestBody` is mirrored through the shared pick. All three chatbot registrations read it (`body: schema.requestBody`).
   - `ChatbotFloatingSchema.floatingConfig` is mirrored through a module-private restatement of `FloatingChatbotConfig`. That restatement judges the six members `FloatingChatbot` destructures, and carries the `triggerIcon` tombstone's runtime half that the objectui#7654 tripwire asked for.
4. **The three zero-read candidates are retired on both faces.** They are `ReportComponentSchema.chartConfig`, `ReportComponentSchema.reportType` and `DetailViewSchema.autoDiscoverRelated`, each `?: never` plus a `retirementTombstone`. `reportType`'s one in-code producer, `specReportToPresentation` in `spec-report.ts`, no longer writes it, and `LegacyReportPresentationLike` no longer declares it.
5. **`DataTableSchema`: 14 of 17 keys go to `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` by name.** They are produced only in code, by `ObjectGrid`'s in-code `data-table` node or `RelatedList`'s, and authored by no document. Three keys fit none of the classes, so the round stopped at them (see "Stopped" below).
6. **The pagination corpus fix, carried from round 3.** `components-basic-pagination/with-item-count.json` no longer authors `pageSize` / `totalItems`, which neither face declares and nothing reads. The plaintext interface block on `content/docs/components/basic/pagination.mdx` stops listing them, and its section is retitled from "With Page Size" to "On a Later Page".
7. **Changesets.** One new: `.changeset/6152-unmirrored-round4.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor, `@object-ui/components` minor, with the break stated). Four dated, append-only corrections were added, each 2 lines with frontmatter unchanged: `6639-objectgrid-title-mirrored.md` (the stale "97 + 1 + 23" sentence), `7654-floating-chatbot-trigger-icon-tombstone.md`, `7655-chatbot-registration-authoring-faces.md` and `9447-detail-view-handler-key-refusal.md`. Every other pending changeset was re-read after the merges, including the 8 that landed since the base, and none is made false by this round.

## Ledger totals, before and after

These are read by the file's own pins (`objectui#7279` derives every figure) and re-counted with the TypeScript parser on the final head.

| ledger | before (`origin/main` `e420df3`) | after (`2cc4ab9`) |

| `UnmirroredDeclared` | 9 entries / 44 keys: 3 / 14 spec-derived, 6 / 30 local | **6 / 20**: 3 / 14 spec-derived, 3 / 6 local |
| `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` | 4 / 9 | **4 / 27** |
| `RuntimeOnlyNamedAllowList` | 1 entry / 2 rows | 3 / 20 |
| cross-ledger | 2 of the 4 are in `UnmirroredDeclared`; union 11 = 9 + 2 | **1 of the 4**; union **9** = 6 + 3 |
| `KnownDrift` | 49 / 86 | 49 / 86, unchanged. This round does not edit its total line; PR #11269's 87 to 86 edit is kept as merged. |

The 24 keys that left `UnmirroredDeclared` moved by three routes, which must not be added up as one repair: 2 were mirrored, 4 were retired, and 18 were reclassified by name. The reclassification is one move seen from both ledgers: it is not new debt, and it mirrors nothing.

## Runtime probe for the three zero-read retirements

AGENTS.md requires more than a source census, because leftover keys reach a renderer as spread props. So the probe used the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry, and varied only the key. It was a one-off: the files were deleted afterwards and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- `report`: the DOM is identical with and without `chartConfig` plus `reportType` (797 = 797 characters, byte-equal). Lit control: changing `title` changes the DOM (805).
- `detail-view`: the DOM is identical with and without `autoDiscoverRelated: true`, after normalising React's `useId` tokens. The only raw difference was `radix-_r_5_` against `radix-_r_d_`. The data-source and `fetch` call log is identical: `getObjectSchema(account)` and two `security/explain` fetches. Lit control: changing `title` changes the DOM (5943 against 5951).

## Ablations

The predictions were written at `4c272dc` before any run, and every leg was restored with the blob equal to `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- **A1:** plant a `LabelSchema` literal carrying `content` into `label.tsx`. Components `tsc --noEmit` exits 2 with exactly one TS2322 there (`'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`), as predicted. This red direction also shows the consumer read the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
- **A2:** restore the four `zod/*.zod.ts` files to base `f61dab1`. `unmirrored-declared-round4-6152.test.ts` reads `27 failed | 6 passed (33)`, exactly as predicted, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2 with its only error in the ledger reconciliation of `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`.
- **A3:** rename the allow-list row `rowCount` to `rowCountRenamed`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2 with exactly two TS2344, at the two allow-list pins, as predicted.

## Verification on the final head `2cc4ab9`

This round resumed after two container restarts, so every run below was redone on `2cc4ab9`. That head carries `origin/main` `e420df3`, merged twice (never rebased): once through PR #11275, and before that through PRs #11267, #11268, #11269, #11271, #11273 and #11274. Each run went through the shared verify lock with at most 2 workers.

- `@object-ui/types`: `type-check` (the `--noEmit`, `tsconfig.examples.json` and `tsconfig.test.json` legs) exits 0; `vitest run packages/types/` gives 299 files and 7498 tests passed; `build` exits 0 (138 emitted files verified).
- Consumers, from the type-checker census: `type-check` exits 0 with 0 TS errors for `components`, `plugin-report`, `plugin-detail` and `plugin-chatbot`. `vitest run packages/plugin-report/ packages/plugin-chatbot/` plus `form-renderers.test.tsx` gives 78 files, 827 passed and 7 skipped. All 228 `plugin-detail` test files, run in two halves, give 227 files passed plus 1 skipped, and 2264 tests passed plus 8 skipped.
- Zod-face consumers: `vitest run examples/schema-catalog/ packages/cli/` plus the 17 app-shell files that import `@object-ui/types/zod` or sit in `metadata-admin/previews/__tests__` give 77 files and 2741 tests passed.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (16 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only; its 4 findings are the 4 dated appends above), `check:control-bytes` (9717 files), `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-snippets` (697 of 697 blocks judged, 0 failed), `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only), `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:prompt-keys`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check-type-check-coverage`. `doc-snippets` and `doc-examples` ran after the scoped build their own `--build-filter` names (35 turbo tasks, all successful).
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 16 lintable changed files gives 0 errors. All 16 were judged and 0 were ignored, a population read from eslint's own output. The 39 warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any`, and the diff adds no explicit `any`. `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no custom rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Governed surface: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 23 paths reports NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`: it needs a console build, and this diff changes no registration.
  - The full `pnpm test` farm and repo-wide lint: CI's.
  - `plugin-grid`: its code and tests are untouched. The 14 reclassified keys moved between two test ledgers and no declaration changed.

## Stopped (ruling needed; reported in the card report with options)

- `DataTableSchema.editable` and `singleClickEdit`. `data-table` reads both and `ObjectGrid` sets both in code, while no document authors them. But `content/docs/components/complex/data-table.mdx` lists both in its interface block and teaches `editable: true`. Filing them runtime-only would contradict that page. Mirroring them would rest on no authored document, and, from the source, an authored `editable: true` stages cell edits locally and persists nothing without the `onRowSave` / `onCellChange` function slots.
- `DataTableSchema.selectionStyle`. `data-table` reads it (`'always'` or `'hover'`), and nothing authors or produces it in either repository.
- Noted, not narrowed: `ChatbotSchema.floatingConfig` has 0 reads on the `chatbot` node (only `chatbot-floating` reads it), which makes it an ADR-0049 narrowing candidate. The `chatbot` half of `floating-chatbot-trigger-icon-retired.test.ts` pins its absence as a tripwire.

## Parallel discipline

PR #11269 and PR #11273 edited `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` in disjoint hunks: the `KnownDrift` total line, the Kanban entry and one `EXCLUSIONS` row. Both merges were clean. This round's ledger edits stay in the `UnmirroredDeclared` / `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` / `RuntimeOnlyNamedAllowList` blocks, their prose totals and its own pairs' entries. Every prose total was reconciled to the measured count above. The diff does not touch `zod/objectql.zod.ts`, `zod/index.zod.ts`, `zod/nested-component-walk.ts`, `strict-authoring-face.ts`, `zod/README.md`, `field-types.ts`, the `DetailViewField` member, or `data-table.tsx` (read only).
